name: ModelVariant667_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant667_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (up to two ribbons of Gouraud quads trail between two model points while sprites, shaded fans and up to thirty-two textured domes appear on a timetable, the last dome ending in a ring of strips); for a non-negative request it reads the 0xC-byte command row indexed by the request for the start delay, sizes and ribbon and sprite colours, seeds the ribbons, sprites, fans and domes and prints the work size, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 4 while the last dome draws its ring, 1 when the last dome ends and 2 once every element is inactive; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the PAL header-684 and 751 images build it through french_model_variant/variant684_entry.c without the work-size printf and its string and bind its data names 0x28 lower; the US slot-1 and Japanese slot-0 images keep wrappers only for the format-string padding byte. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
